span.p: Start: Test rehearsal

div.style: color: rgb(26, 43, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
0. Prerequisites and approvals
MySQL version, CIDRs, tooling versions, change window
All teams

div.style: color: rgb(26, 43, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. Create Test-Prod and Test-DR accounts, IAM, quotas
Cloud governance, Security

div.style: color: rgb(26, 43, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. Bootstrap EKS in both accounts,
deploy the app on MySQL, seed test data
Platform, App

div.style: color: rgb(26, 43, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. Create Aurora cluster in same VPC
subnet group, SG, parameter groups
Aurora DBA, Network

div.style: color: rgb(26, 43, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. Sync: repl user, internal NLB, dump + load,
app user, start binlog replication
MySQL DBA, Aurora DBA, Platform

div.style: color: rgb(61, 48, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Replica running,
lag near 0, test writes
visible on Aurora?

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Troubleshoot network,
binlog, credentials

div.style: color: rgb(74, 16, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5.1 Record replicas, scale the app to 0
App, Platform

div.style: color: rgb(74, 16, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5.2 Source super_read_only = ON,
binlog position matches on Aurora
MySQL DBA, Aurora DBA

div.style: color: rgb(61, 48, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5.3 Row counts and
checksums match?

div.style: color: rgb(74, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5.4 Stop and reset replication,
Aurora writable
Aurora DBA

div.style: color: rgb(74, 16, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6.1-6.2 Back up the DB secret
and point it at Aurora
Platform

div.style: color: rgb(74, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6.3 Scale the app back up
App, Platform

div.style: color: rgb(61, 48, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6.4 Smoke test:
API, admin, orders OK?

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Rollback A: source read/write,
scale app up on MySQL

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Rollback B: restore secret backup,
source read/write, scale app up

div.style: color: rgb(26, 43, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7. Create global cluster, DR VPC,
add eu-west-2 secondary (online)
Aurora DBA, Network

div.style: color: rgb(61, 48, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Replication lag
stable and low?

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Check instance size,
write load, KMS

div.style: color: rgb(26, 43, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8. Cross-account VPC peering, routes,
SG, DNS, connectivity test from DR EKS
Network, Security, Platform

div.style: color: rgb(26, 43, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
9. Switchover drill to London,
DR app up, validate, failback
All teams

div.style: color: rgb(61, 48, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Drill passed,
RTO/RPO recorded?

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix gaps,
repeat drill

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

(Prod is already Aurora: steps 7 to 9 + DMS retirement)
